data.where_to_query: gold.mart_airport_weather_typed: one typed row per airport_weather event, the served surface for this category. The silver table the expert context names (silver.silver_airport_weather) is its source and is not served; the star tables are the provenance layer.

expert_context.category_limitations: Twelve airport-hours of the window have no observation; gust is null when no gust was reported; wind direction is a direction in degrees and never additive. The vintage mix (2013 observations, 2026 airport attributes) carries through from silver.
expert_context.category_purpose: Declares how silver.silver_airport_weather maps into the unified event star as the airport_weather fact category: one fact row per airport per hour in January through June 2013 at hour grain on the conformed calendar (observed_hour_utc), the airport attributes as dimensions and the nine observation quantities as measures. expert_context.category_usage: Engine input only. The typed surface mart_airport_weather_typed (D-36) answers questions about conditions at an airport in an hour; a flight's weather at departure joins on airport_code equals origin_airport and observed_hour_utc equals departure_hour_utc, the hour both categories share in the timeframe group (Amendment R).

cross_category_joins.example_sql: SELECT flights.carrier_code, avg(flights.dep_delay_minutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes FROM gold.mart_flights_typed AS flights JOIN gold.mart_airport_weather_typed AS airport_weather ON flights.origin_airport = airport_weather.airport_code AND flights.departure_hour_utc = airport_weather.observed_hour_utc WHERE airport_weather.precip_inches > 0 GROUP BY flights.carrier_code ORDER BY avg_dep_delay_minutes DESC
cross_category_joins.name: flights_to_origin_weather
cross_category_joins.note: Every flight's weather at its origin airport in its departure hour, both sides on the conformed calendar (UTC hours) and the conformed airport code. Measured 0.9994 over the typed surfaces at the Arc 6 build: 97 of 166,158 flights fall in the six airport-hours the nycflights13 weather feed has no observation for. The floor is declared below the measurement so a weather refresh that adds coverage passes and one that loses it fails (the M2 discipline, D-41). Destination weather is out of reach by construction: the weather feed covers the three New York City airports only.

expert_context.how_to_read: Read silver.silver_airport_weather for conditions at EWR, JFK, or LGA in a given hour: temperatures in Fahrenheit, wind in mph, precipitation in inches for the hour, pressure in millibars, visibility in miles. observed_hour_utc is the conformed calendar key at hour grain shared with the flights category: a flight's departure_hour_utc at the same airport is the same hour, so weather at departure joins on airport_code equals origin_airport and the hour.

The series has no hour 0 on January 1, and March 10 has 23 local hours (the spring-forward day). Gust is null on three quarters of rows (no gust reported), pressure on about 12 percent, wind direction on 2 percent. The airport join resolves all three airports (100 percent).
